entity_types: Association (levels 1-3, filed with Interior Ministry / wali / hakem) and foundation (min endowment 3,000,000 MRU, notarized act, publication in Journal Officiel); foreign associations may register branches (law 2021-004).
cost_time: Fees unpublished (as of 2026; law requires 'droits de timbres', no amount published). Official portal (procedures.gov.mr) states 59-day processing; law 2021-004 Art.7: final receipt within 60 days max.
foreign_no_presence: partial - direct local registration effectively requires Mauritanian presence (local siege, NNI national ID of each founder, notarized deposit act per Interior Ministry procedure); law 2021-004 Art.42 lets an established foreign association register a branch via Foreign Affairs declaration plus framework agreement with a ministry.
corrections: Law 2021-004 replaced the 1964 regime: declaration-based, receipt within 60 days max; foundation vehicle added; official portal states 59 days.
